description:
Secure your accounts with Autheris — a privacy-first two-factor authentication (2FA) app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

Autheris generates the time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) that protect your most important accounts, and keeps the secrets behind them on your device. No account, no sign-up, no ads.

NOW ON APPLE WATCH
• One Code at a Time — Your codes on your wrist, each with a live countdown. Turn the Digital Crown to move between them.
• Read-Only by Design — There is no copy, no editing and no settings on the watch. Your iPhone stays the one place codes are managed.
• Works Without Your iPhone — Codes are generated on the watch itself, so they keep counting down with your phone out of reach or switched off.

KEY FEATURES
• One-Tap Codes — Copy a code with a single tap. The clipboard clears itself after 60 seconds.
• Pin and Reorder — Pin the codes you use most to the top, and drag the rest into whatever order suits you.
• Recently Deleted — Delete a code by mistake? It stays on your device for 7 days, ready to restore.
• QR Scanning — Add an account by scanning a QR code, or choose a screenshot from your photo library.
• Time-Based and Counter-Based Codes — TOTP for almost every service, and HOTP for the ones that hand you a counter instead, each with SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512 and 6 to 10 digits. If a service rejects your codes, the algorithm is editable per account.
• Import — Bring your token generator accounts across from Google Authenticator, Aegis, andOTP or 2FAS.
• Search — Find any account instantly, however long your list gets.
• Issuer Icons — Familiar brand marks so you can spot an account at a glance.
• Countdown Ring — A clear, colour-customisable ring shows how long each verification code has left.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Face ID / Touch ID Lock — Locks when opened, and again after 30 seconds away.
• Blurred When Backgrounded — Content blurs when you switch apps, and your codes are hidden in the app switcher.
• Protected While Recording — Codes are covered whenever your screen is being recorded or mirrored.
• Secrets Stay on Your Device — Codes and setup keys are kept in your device's Keychain and never leave it unless you export them or turn on iCloud Sync.
• Encrypted Backups — Save an AES-256-GCM encrypted backup protected by a password only you know.
• Optional iCloud Sync — Off by default. When you enable it, your secrets are end-to-end encrypted by CloudKit, and the developer cannot read them.
• No Account, No Tracking — Nothing to sign up for, no analytics, no advertising. Autheris is open source.

Install Autheris, add an account, and keep your second factor — and your 2-step login — under your own control.
promotionalText: Your two-factor codes, kept on your device. No account, no server, no tracking — on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
whatsNew:
Autheris 3.1 is a reliability update, mostly for iCloud sync and counter-based codes.

• A counter-based code never goes back to a code you've already used — not when syncing, editing or restoring a backup.

• An edit made while a sync is running is no longer undone, and editing a code changes only what you changed, so a rename made on another device isn't overwritten.

• Delete Tokens from iCloud now waits for any sync in progress, so your codes can't be uploaded again straight afterwards, and shows that it's working. It also reminds you to turn off iCloud Sync on your other devices first.

• Apple Watch no longer stops updating after your iPhone's clock was set ahead.

• Restoring a backup that lists the same code twice no longer makes Autheris quit.

• Codes with unusual settings, such as a 10-second period, keep them when you edit them, and the period steps in 15-second increments from any value.

• iOS no longer offers to save a setup key as a password.

• Encrypted backups whose password has accented letters open on any device, and sync status messages now appear in your language.

Your codes, iCloud sync and other settings are exactly where you left them.
